title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: PLAC tip — fights pre-existence imputation; tip before GAR 4 (act+corruption)
pass_a_gloss: He cannot answer that root-and-branch point, because—as already noted—I am opposing an imputation believed to have stood long before we began to be, and by which we supposedly became true sinners and guilty. Tip before GAR 4 joins Adam's act with the corruption it begot.
pass_b_english: Which he cannot answer me, because, as I have already observed, I oppose the imputation which is believed to have long been, before we began to be. And by that imputation it was brought about that we truly and properly became sinners and guilty.
source_text: Id quod mihi respondere non potest, quoniam, ut iam observavi, imputationem oppugno quae diu fuisse creditur, antequam esse inciperemus, & qua factum sit ut vere & proprie peccatores & rei fieremus.

choices.choice: Targets pre-existence imputation; tip before GAR 4
